# Create Pull Request

## Purpose
- Create a pull request comment with the given body.

## Inputs

| Key            | Purpose                                | Required | Default | Example |
|----------------|----------------------------------------|----------|---------|---------|
| branch         | The name of target branch              | true     | -       |         |
| base           | The name of base branch                | true     | -       |         |
| title          | The title of Pull Request              | true     | -       |         |
| body           | The body of Pull Request               | false    | -       |         |
| labels         | Add labels of the Pull Request         | false    | -       |         |
| assignee       | Set assignee of the Pull Request       | false    | -       |         |
| reviewer       | Set reviewer of the Pull Request       | false    | -       |         |
| team-reviewers | Set team-reviewers of the Pull Request | false    | -       |         |
| draft          | Open Pull Request as draft             | false    | false   |         |

## Outputs
N/A
